import numpy as np

# Sample grasp pose
grasp_position, grasp_quaternion = sample_grasp_pose("red cube")

# Get object poses and extents
red_position, red_quaternion, red_extent = get_object_pose("red cube", return_bbox_extent=True)
green_position, green_quaternion, green_extent = get_object_pose("green cube", return_bbox_extent=True)

# Open gripper
open_gripper()

# Approach and grasp the red cube
goto_pose(grasp_position, grasp_quaternion, z_approach=0.1)
close_gripper()

# Lift the red cube
lift_position = grasp_position.copy()
lift_position[2] += 0.2
goto_pose(lift_position, grasp_quaternion)

# Place the red cube on top of the green cube
place_z = green_position[2] + green_extent[2]/2 + red_extent[2]/2
goto_pose(np.array([green_position[0], green_position[1], place_z]), grasp_quaternion, z_approach=0.1)

# Release
open_gripper()
